literal: He hoarded - at the place of - abundant - great wealth - that - he does not enjoy - he is dead - to do - remained - nothing.
translation: He who hoards vast wealth but does not enjoy it is as good as dead. There is nothing left for him to do.
modern: தன்னிடம் நிறைய செல்வத்தை சேர்த்து வைத்தும் அதனை அனுபவிக்காதவன் இறந்தவனுக்குச் சமமாவான். அவனால் செய்யக்கூடியது வேறு ஒன்றும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet describes the ultimate uselessness of wealth when it is merely hoarded. The word 'வைத்தான்' refers to one who just keeps or hoards wealth, while 'உண்ணான்' means he does not consume or enjoy it. The poet boldly declares such a person 'செத்தான்' (dead), because without using his wealth for himself or others, his existence has no purpose or remaining potential ('செயக்கிடந்தது இல்').
